scenes.name: The return
caption: KUALA LUMPUR ATC · MIDNIGHT
FICTION · INSPIRED BY THE REAL MH370

lines.text: After years of silence, the mysterious MH370 signal returned.
lines.sub: After years of silence... the mysterious MH370 signal... returned.

lines.text: Inside the control room, the radar showed something impossible. An aircraft, approaching Kuala Lumpur.
lines.sub: Inside the control room... the radar showed something impossible. An aircraft... approaching Kuala Lumpur.

lines.text: MH370... you are cleared to land.
The radar screen went completely dark. The signal disappeared forever.
lines.sub: The radar screen went completely dark. The signal... disappeared forever.

lines.text: Two hundred and thirty-nine souls. One unanswered mystery. MH370. The flight that never came home.
lines.sub: 239 souls... one unanswered mystery. MH370... the flight that never came home.

scenes.name: End card
end: The supernatural events in this series are fiction.
MH370 disappeared on 8 March 2014 with 239 people aboard.
Its main wreckage has never been found.
